summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) enclosing a news release announcing an investor and analyst site visit to its consolidated Beatty Mining District in southern Nevada on 25 September 2026, covering progress on the North Bullfrog Project and the Tier-One Arthur Gold Project. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanics are disclosed; the presentation pack is posted on the company website. This is routine investor-relations disclosure, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
